newsitem.title: CANADA: Axcan drug gets US FDA committee okay.
newsitem.headline: Axcan drug gets US FDA committee okay.

text.p: Pharmaceutical firm Axcan Pharma Inc said on Tuesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration's Gastrointestinal Expert Advisory Committee approved its URSO drug for the liver disease primary biliary cirrhosis.
The committee recommended the FDA approve the drug for that application, Axcan said. The FDA is expected to make a decision before the end of 1996 or early in 1997.

"Axcan estimates the potential U.S. market for this application of URSO to range up to US$100 million in annual sales," it said in a statement. About 50,000 people in the U.S. have the progressive liver disease.
Axcan also said it was in discussions with several U.S. pharmaceutical firms that are interested in marketing or co-marketing the drug. Axcan will soon decide on a partner.
